actual: After all373genuine core modules passed, the genuine hash executable build requested missing generic native-link :c.o artifacts and wrote new cache artifacts in shared package .lake/build/ir directories.
impact: This violated intended read-only reuse of generic cache directories. Observed compiler logs were native C-object jobs, not new mathematical sources. All9packages were checked with git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no and had clean tracked source. No pre-run complete .olean hash census exists, so no stronger hash-based unchanged-object claim is made.
response: Sent SIGTERM only to owned hash subtree, let controller record failure returncode -15, preserved all logs/373successful module receipts, and copied exact pinned packages into experiment-owned /data scratch before further writable native-link builds.
cleanup: Do not delete or restore files in the shared generic caches: they are outside the experiment-owned cleanup boundary. Private package copies are regenerable and may be removed only after completed official runs/receipts checked and no process uses them.
